Name: Slightly Cuter Harvey Sprite (Content Patcher)
Author: Girafarig
Description:
Harvey is my favorite bachelor, but his OW sprite always looked a bit derpy to me (not representative of the handsome man I know he is!). This is my personal edit I've been using for the past few years, but decided to share since 1.6 has come around. 

Comes with three new color options, in case you don't like his blue winter look. Red, Orange, and Classic Harvey Green.

Requires Content Patcher

Let me know if you have any issues!

Pairs well with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7325]Better Beach Outfits Mod[/url]

Let me know if there's anything else y'all'd like to see!

Downloads.Description: Makes Harvey's OW Sprite slightly cuter and adds options for different colors for his winter outfit!

Manifest.Description: Makes Harvey's Sprite a bit more handsome and cute.
